behavioral_defect_verdict: PASS for updated guarded launches across TMPDIR and for an existing registered external legacy holder. A late launch from obsolete guard code remains outside the new guard's mutual exclusion: it can take its old lock after the new guard's one-time legacy scan. This requires continuing to launch obsolete code after cutover; no overlapping heavy workload was launched or observed.
code_quality_verdict: The lock-root repair is small and preserves the existing admission and cleanup path. The focused suite is not portable because its registered-external-root assertion hardcodes UID 501 and a machine-specific volume path; it also passes the same lock argument to both reservation children, so that test alone cannot prove the real guard chooses a shared path. The bounded real-guard probe supplies that missing integration evidence on this host. Repair the portable fixture before treating the test as a durable guard.

evidence.result: PASS: two separate Node processes using the HEAD root expression and distinct scratch TMPDIR values each created a heavy directory; their paths differed. This proves the original independent reservation namespaces. The probe removed its scratch roots.

evidence.case: real guard default holder versus external TMPDIR contender
evidence.result: Default check held /var/tmp/matrx-stabilization-resource-501/heavy with owner.json. External TMPDIR check exited 2 with RESOURCE_HEAVY_BUSY before preflight. The first check completed its 60-second measurement, emitted RESOURCE_ADMITTED with no reasons, exited 0, and removed heavy. No child workload was launched.

evidence.case: registered old external holder versus new default caller
evidence.result: A harmless heavy directory at the registered old external root caused the real new default-TMPDIR check to exit 2 with RESOURCE_LEGACY_HEAVY_BUSY. The probe removed only its marker. Both old and new roots were empty afterward.
No stabilization-resource.mjs process or heavy directory remained in the new or registered old root. No owner token was exposed in report output.

transition_scope.already_running_old_holder: Blocked by known legacy lease directory and by old-runner/process census, as independently checked for the registered external root.
transition_scope.obsolete_code_started_after_new_scan: Not blocked: the obsolete guard does not know the new /var/tmp lock. Preventing that scenario would require a separate cutover discipline or a backward-compatibility bridge. It is not evidence of failure among updated callers.
transition_scope.machine_specific_legacy_path: Reasonable as a temporary registration of the documented local external profile for this one cutover. It is not a portable permanent policy value and should be retired once old leases cannot be active.

blockers: Make the final legacy-discovery test use temporary directories and the current UID so it runs on other hosts.
limitations: No real build, browser test, or other heavy child was launched.
The preflight result measures this host at probe time only; it is not product verification.
No obsolete runner was launched concurrently with the new runner.
